title: Optimizer promotion validator and browser receipts
objective: Implement fail-closed promotion comparison/receipt validation and authenticated JSON receipts for machine optimizer domains in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit

oracles: Recomputed promotion decisions, exact O0/O2/browser routes, malformed and stale artifact receipts, and paired-sample fixtures

handoff.summary: Implemented shared-schema promotion construction and validation with recomputed ABBA paired bootstrap evidence, accepted/rejected/inconclusive decisions, exact checkout/build/artifact/browser/cited-input authority, narrow baseline exceptions, resource/platform/neighbor/losing-target gates, schema-validated CLI inputs, and deterministic browser machine-domain receipts. Focused schema/promotion/browser tests and the compiler suite pass on linux-x64; a clean full build also passed.
risks: A receipt-authenticated Chromium/Firefox/WebKit run must be repeated from the final clean integrated commit after rebuilding the production Wasm artifact; the lane's earlier all-engine direct run passed but is not a current-commit promotion receipt.
linux-arm64, windows-x64, and macos-arm64 VM receipts remain integration work; their absence is represented as unavailable/inconclusive and cannot promote.

The browser runner adds exact flint identity/version consumer paths to the generated native-export inventory. That coordinated refresh is root commit dc4a1c60 and must land with the implementation; architecture:check passes with it.

There is no standalone receipt schema for every ancillary status class. The CLI validates campaign/workload/profile/dossier/browser documents and permits an exact validated document ID to support correctness, adversarial, route, resource, platform, or losing-candidate roles; a missing validated document stays inconclusive.

No broad higher-genus baseline waiver is present. Any future exception must name one active Sage.js issue, test, platform, and exact failure fingerprint, and an unused or mismatched exception rejects promotion.
next_steps: On the clean integration commit run: pnpm build && pnpm --dir packages/flint-wasm build; then node packages/flint-wasm/test/optimizer-machine-domains-browser.mjs --engines chromium,firefox,webkit --required-engines chromium,firefox,webkit --receipt /tmp/optimizer-browser-receipt.json; finally node scripts/optimizer-platform-validate.cjs browser /tmp/optimizer-browser-receipt.json.

On bench-1 and bench-arm, use a fresh exact integration checkout and run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm parallel:cache -- prepare; pnpm build; node --test test/optimizer-promotion.cjs test/optimizer-browser-receipt.cjs test/optimizer-development-schemas.cjs; pnpm test:compiler; pnpm architecture:check; node scripts/optimizer-platform-validate.cjs host --json.

On m1 run the same POSIX sequence; on windows run the corresponding commands in native PowerShell with Node >=22.22.2 and no WSL/MSYS2/MinGW. Preserve each exact commit, workspace fingerprint, host JSON, command exit status, and test failure fingerprint in platform evidence.

Only construct an accepted receipt after all required current bindings and validated-input IDs are supplied. Missing build, artifact, browser, profile, workload, campaign, dashboard, compiler-decision, or ancillary evidence must remain inconclusive; a mismatch must remain rejected.
